row_tax_mixed: Property Tax Proration (Charge or Credit by Closing Date)
tile_no_payoffs_sub: No mortgage or liens to pay off
final_figures: The title company's settlement statement gives the final figures.
note_property_type_unit: Property type taken as {type} from the unit number.
note_closing_date: Closing on {dates} is an expected date; the actual date moves the tax proration.
note_commission_default: Commission at the default {pct} in total (listing and buyer's agent); the listing agreement's terms replace it.
note_tax: Property tax prorated from Jan 1 to the day before closing ({basis}).
note_tax_unpaid: Property tax prorated from Jan 1 to the day before closing ({basis}), assuming this year's bill is still unpaid at closing; if the seller pays it first, the buyer credits back the rest of the year instead.
note_tax_paid: Property tax: the seller paid this year's bill ({basis}), so the buyer credits back closing to Dec 31.
note_tax_bill_paid: This year's tax bill ({basis}) is assumed paid by its {due} due date, before closing, so the buyer credits back closing to Dec 31; if it's still unpaid at closing, the seller is charged from Jan 1 instead.
note_tax_mixed: Property tax ({basis}): a closing after the bill's {due} due date assumes it paid, so the buyer credits back closing to Dec 31; a closing before it charges the seller from Jan 1 to the day before closing.
note_tax_bill_unpaid: This year's tax bill is assumed still unpaid at closing; if the seller pays it first, the buyer credits back the rest of the year instead.
note_title_fees: Title company fees are typical {whose} charges; the title company's quote replaces them.
note_estoppel: The HOA estoppel fee is a typical {whose} charge; the association's fee schedule replaces it.
note_national: Estimates, not local figures: {items}. Local rates or a title quote replace them.
note_owner_title: The buyer customarily pays the owner's title policy here, so it isn't a seller cost.
note_transfer_tax: No state transfer tax in {state}; a few cities and counties add their own, so confirm with the title company.
note_payoff: Payoffs are estimates until the lender's payoff letter, which adds interest through the closing date.
note_payoff_balance: The mortgage payoff is estimated from the statement balance plus a month's interest; payoffs are estimates until the lender's payoff letter, which adds interest through the closing date.
note_not_included: Not included: liens or judgments, HOA dues owed or prorated, and utility bills.
note_firpta: The seller is a foreign person: FIRPTA may require the buyer to withhold up to 15% of the price at closing. Confirm with the title company or a CPA.
note_no_hoa: No HOA assumed; one would add its estoppel fee and any dues owed to the costs.
reason_state: the property's state isn't known, so every cost is a national estimate
reason_tax: this year's property tax proration isn't included (taxes here are paid in arrears, so the seller credits the buyer from Jan 1; {items} would add it)
warn_short: At {price} the costs and payoffs exceed the sale price: the seller would bring about {amount} to closing. Say so plainly in the reply.

missing_words.deed transfer tax: transfer tax (or confirmation there is none)
missing_words.who pays owner's title: who customarily pays the owner's title policy
